data.description: 这是一个带有实验性质的库，提供使用伪终端文件描述符创建进程的功能，以探索本机上的可能性代码来实现 PTY 与否；而不是去利用纯 FFI 和阻塞隔离的方式。预计它将比当前的实现，即（https://github.com/TerminalStudio/pty）更具稳定性。
data.label: Flutter Pty

data.description: This is an experimental library that provides the ability to create processes using pseudo-terminal file descriptors to explore the possibility of implementing PTY on the native side; rather than using pure FFI and blocking isolation. It is expected to be more stable than the current implementation at (https://github.com/TerminalStudio/pty).
data.label: Flutter Pty
